title: Terminal
description: A green phosphor screen asks "shall we play a record?" and lists the Beatles albums like a 1983 menu. Pick one and its cover is rastered in dithered phosphor line by line while the tracklist types out on a teletype rhythm.
intent: One old screen made beautiful: a real CRT pass (curvature, scanlines, bloom, phosphor persistence) over a plain lowercase record menu, so moving the selection leaves glowing trails and every character arrives with a key click.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (green CRT terminal text, menu list)
